```{r label = "setup", include = FALSE}
library(qwraps2)
options(qwraps2_markup = "markdown")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE)
```


```{r}
library(phoenix)
packageVersion("phoenix")
```

This is a quick start guide for using the `phoenix` R package.  Additional
detail is found in the other vignettes.

# Row-wise scoring

The `sepsis` data.frame contails a moment in time recored for 20 synthetic patients.
```{r}
str(sepsis)
```

To apply the Phoenix scoring rubric to this data set:

```{r}
phoenix8_scores <-
  phoenix8(
    # respiratory
    pf_ratio = pao2 / fio2,
    sf_ratio = ifelse(spo2 <= 97, spo2 / fio2, NA_real_),
    invasive_mechanical_ventilation = vent,
    other_respiratory_support = as.integer(fio2 > 0.21),
    # cardiovascular
    vasoactives = dobutamine + dopamine + epinephrine + milrinone +
    norepinephrine + vasopressin,
    lactate = lactate,
    age = age, # Also used in the renal assessment.
    mean_arterial_pressure = dbp + (sbp - dbp)/3,
    # coagulation
    platelets = platelets,
    inr = inr,
    d_dimer = d_dimer,
    fibrinogen = fibrinogen,
    # neurologic
    gcs = gcs_total,
    fixed_pupils = as.integer(pupil == "both-fixed"),
    # endocrine
    glucose = glucose,
    # immunologic
    anc = anc,
    alc = alc,
    # renal (also uses age)
    creatinine = creatinine,
    # hepatic
    bilirubin = bilirubin,
    alt = alt,

    # the data set
    data = sepsis
  )
str(phoenix8_scores)
```

# Applying to EHR Data

The data set `phx` has synthetic data for three encounters/patients.

```{r}
str(phx)
```

## Prepare Data

```{r}
split_phx <- split(phx, f = phx[["variable"]])

split_phx[["o2support"]] <- split_phx[["oxygen_flow"]]
split_phx[["o2support"]][["value"]] <- as.integer(split_phx[["oxygen_flow"]][["value"]] > 0)
split_phx[["o2support"]][["variable"]] <- "o2support"
split_phx[["oxygen_flow"]] <- NULL

prepper <- function(x) {
  variable <- unique(x[["variable"]])
  stopifnot(length(variable) == 1L)
  common_args <- list(id.vars = "encounter_id", eclock = "encounter_clock", value.var = "value")

  map <- switch(variable,
    absolute_lymphocyte_count              = "alc",
    absolute_neutrophil_count              = "anc",
    age_months                             = "age",
    alanine_aminotransferase               = "alt",
    creatinine                             = "creatinine",
    diastolic_blood_pressure_arterial_line = "dbp_arterial",
    diastolic_blood_pressure_cuff          = "dbp_cuff",
    fibrin_degradation_fragment            = "ddimer",
    fibrinogen                             = "fibrinogen",
    fraction_of_inspired_oxygen            = "fio2",
    glasgow_coma_scale_eye                 = "gcseye",
    glasgow_coma_scale_motor               = "gcsmotor",
    glasgow_coma_scale_total               = "gcstotal",
    glasgow_coma_scale_verbal              = "gcsverbal",
    glucose                                = "glucose",
    infectious_test                        = "antiinfectioustests",
    international_normalized_ratio         = "inr",
    lactate                                = "lactate",
    left_pupil_fixed                       = "pupilleft",
    mean_airway_pressure_ventilator        = "mean_airway_pressure_ventilator",
    mean_arterial_pressure_arterial_line   = "mean_arterial_pressure_arterial",
    mean_arterial_pressure_cuff            = "mean_arterial_pressure_cuff",
    partial_pressure_of_arterial_oxygen    = "pao2",
    peripheral_capillary_oxygen_saturation = "spo2",
    platelets                              = "platelets",
    positive_end_expiratory_pressure       = "positive_end_expiratory_pressure",
    right_pupil_fixed                      = "pupilright",
    systemic_antimicrobial_medication      = "antimicrobials",
    systemic_vasoactive_epinephrine        = "epinephrine",
    systemic_vasoactive_milrinone          = "milrinone",
    systolic_blood_pressure_arterial_line  = "sbp_arterial",
    systolic_blood_pressure_cuff           = "sbp_cuff",
    total_bilirubin                        = "bilirubin",
    o2support                              = "o2support"
  )

  f <- get(paste0("prepare_", map), mode = "function")

  if (variable == "age_months") {
    rtn <- do.call(f, c(list(x = x), common_args[-2]))
  } else {
    rtn <- do.call(f, c(list(x = x), common_args))
  }
  setNames(list(rtn), map)
}

prepared_inputs <- unname(lapply(split_phx, prepper))
prepared_inputs <- unlist(prepared_inputs, recursive = FALSE, use.names = TRUE)
prepared_data   <- do.call(prepare_phoenix_data, prepared_inputs)
scored_data     <- score_prepared_phoenix_data(prepared_data)
scored_data
```

The output is a `data.frame` with one row per encounter.  The
`suspected_infection` column is a 0/1 indicator for suspected infection, `odss_4_` is the
organ dysfunction summary score based on the four systems for Phoenix
(respiratory, cardiovascular, neurologic, and coagulation).  The `pss_4_` is the
Phoenix score, it is the product of the `suspected_infection` and `odss_4_`
columns.  `sepsis_` and `septic_shock_` are 0/1 indicators.   The suffix
`jama2024` indicate these are the values consistent with the aggregation method
used in @Sanchez-Pinto2024 and @Schlapbach2024.
